content.text: Translation of petróleo – Portuguese–English dictionary petróleo noun [ masculine ] /pe'tɾɔlɪʊ/ Add to word list Add to word list ● óleo usado como fonte de energia oil , petrol uma região rica em petróleo a region rich in oil extrair petróleo to extract oil (Translation of petróleo from the GLOBAL Portuguese–English Dictionary © 2018 K Dictionaries Ltd) Translation of petróleo | PASSWORD Portuguese–English Dictionary petróleo noun petroleum [noun] oil in its raw, unrefined form, which is found in natural wells below the earth’s surface and from which petrol, paraffin etc are obtained.
